# CCMAF Skills — catalogue

**72 skills** in **13 packs**. Each skill is a self-contained directory: a lean `SKILL.md` plus on-demand reference docs.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-core@ccmaf-skills        # everyone
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-engineering@ccmaf-skills # every developer
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-<pack>@ccmaf-skills      # the packs your work needs
```

Or install everything at once with `/plugin install ccmaf-skills@ccmaf-skills` (all 72 skills; a larger skill listing in every session).

## Core (`ccmaf-skills-core`)

The agent-workflow disciplines every session benefits from: de-slopped prose, technical writing, docs-grounding, usage-limit hygiene, model calibration, systematic debugging, reviewable plans and recaps, committable diagrams, and the two shells.

**Audience:** Everyone — install this first. · **Install:** `/plugin install ccmaf-skills-core@ccmaf-skills` · [Pack README](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/README.md)

|---|---|---|

| [`read-the-damn-docs`](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/skills/read-the-damn-docs/SKILL.md) | Ground claims in version-matched official docs and installed source, not training memory. | 3 |
| [`stay-within-limits`](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/skills/stay-within-limits/SKILL.md) | Keep long-running or parallel agent work inside usage limits: budget, checkpoint, stop on a soft threshold. | 3 |
| [`systematic-debugging`](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md) | Reproduce, minimise, bisect, test one falsifiable hypothesis at a time, fix the root cause, add a regression test. | 6 |

| [`uncanny`](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/skills/uncanny/SKILL.md) | Remove AI tells from prose so it reads as human-written, without swapping in a different costume. | 4 |
| [`visual-plan`](plugins/ccmaf-skills-core/skills/visual-plan/SKILL.md) | A grounded, reviewable Markdown implementation plan with diagrams and an open-questions gate, before any code. | 5 |
